name: rimworld-modding
title_zh: 从零搓出能上创意工坊的 RimWorld 模组
tagline_zh: 别在论坛翻三天帖了。环境、Def、Harmony 补丁、贴图、发布，一条链走完。零基础到能跑。
tagline_en: Stop digging forums for 3 days. Full chain: env, Defs, Harmony, art, Workshop release. Zero to running, works.
desc_en: RimWorld mod 制作全流程指南——覆盖环境搭建、XML Def 系统、C# 开发、Harmony 补丁、 资源制作和 Steam Workshop 发布。适用于零基础到进阶的 RimWorld 1.6 mod 开发者。 跨平台支持 Claude Code / TRAE / Copilot CLI / Codex / Gemini CLI / Cursor 等主流 AI 编程工具。 触发词：RimWorld, 环世界, rimworld, RW, mod, Mod, 模组, Def, XML, ThingDef, Harmony, Patch, 补丁, 武器, 建筑, 物品, 生物, 植物, 派系, 事件, Steam Workshop, 创意工坊, C#, DLL, 编译
why_zh: 不是零散教程堆砌，而是按真实开发顺序排好的完整流程。每一步都有可执行代码和验证点。
why_en: Not scattered tutorials—a real dev pipeline in order. Executable code and checkpoints at each step, so the AI never stalls midway.
limit_zh: 只认 RimWorld 1.6 的 mod 开发；不涉及游戏内剧本编辑、DLC 专属系统。
limit_en: RimWorld 1.6 mods only. No scenario editing, DLC-specific systems, or advanced HugsLib. Ends at local run + Workshop upload; no store page polish or.
title_en: Ship RimWorld mods from scratch: XML, C#, Harmony, Workshop
